translations.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
translations.bsb: Now people were even bringing their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them. And when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.
translations.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
translations.asv: And they were bringing unto him also their babes, that he should touch them: but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
